recognize_zh: CD56 對側向散射的散佈圖中，紫色主要族群呈強 CD56 陽性（約 10^2）且側向散射低到中等，與 CD56 陰性、高側向散射的顆粒球分開，支持神經內分泌來源的腫瘤細胞（如神經母細胞瘤）。
features: Ungated CD56 vs SS plot with a dominant highlighted population showing bright CD56 expression (about 10^2)
The CD56-bright population has low to intermediate side scatter
Gray CD56-negative high side scatter cluster corresponding to granulocytes
Small CD56-negative low side scatter population (residual lymphoid/other cells)
Large proportion of events in the CD56-bright cluster, indicating heavy marrow infiltration
describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis of the bone marrow shows a dominant population with bright CD56 expression and low to intermediate side scatter, distinct from the CD56-negative granulocytes with high side scatter. When correlated with the CD45-negative gating of the same population, this indicates a CD45-negative, CD56-bright non-hematopoietic cell population. CD56 is not lineage specific, so confirmation with GD2 or morphology/immunohistochemistry is needed. Findings are consistent with bone marrow infiltration by metastatic neuroblastoma.

ddx.dx: NK-cell neoplasm or CD56-positive hematolymphoid neoplasm
ddx.vs: NK cells and CD56-positive myeloma or AML are CD45-positive (myeloma CD138/CD38-bright), whereas this population is CD45-negative.
BPDCN is CD56-positive but CD45 dim-positive with CD4, CD123 and TCF4 expression.
These CD45-negative tumors can express CD56, so GD2 positivity by flow or PHOX2B/synaptophysin by IHC is required to favor neuroblastoma.
